data_fields.name: cron_duration
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (cron rules have no end; defect)

best_idea: A single event row with a start-once activation guard, an end pass that undoes exactly what that row changed, and one once-per-minute gate, all on the server.
decision_why: Keep window rows, start-once guard and end-undo pass as server zone data; use null for unset fields, collect-then-remove, and an explicit cron duration. Reject per-zone copies and the global rule reset (one ledger, scoped modifiers).
acceptance: A server test: a 20:00-21:00 broadcast is sent exactly once at 20:00, the zone flag is on until 21:00, and an event with hour 20 minute 0 opens at 20:00 whatever minute the server booted in.
